why: I checked every command in both briefs against the repository facts. Builder step 5 says to run `npm run lint && npm run test:unit`, but package.json defines only one script, `{"test":"node --test"}`. There are no `lint` or `test:unit` scripts and no step adds them, so `npm run lint` fails with a missing-script error. Because of the `&&`, the tests never run either, so the command can't run as written. The other commands are fine: the builder's `node -e` call, the verifier's three `node -e` checks (their JavaScript syntax is valid) and the verifier's `npm test` would all run. The single broken builder command is enough to fail the criterion.
